description:
The Mach E is a flat handlebar 700c wheel electric bike, capable of challenging your fitness, or navigating the urban jungle, with a little help along the way.

The sleek looking, modern aluminium frame based around it’s non electric sibling, uses lightweight 6061 T6 double butted aluminium, providing guaranteed comfort and versatility. Whether you ride the Mach 3 VRX around your local forest loop at the weekend or load it up with panniers for your regular commute to work, this bike delivers. The geometry supports a more upright, comfortable and accessible riding position, but remains ‘sporty’.

Built with the industry leading Shimano STEPS E6100 e-bike system, delivering a fully enhanced riding experience. The powerful lightweight motor (only 2.8kg) is designed for smooth, intelligent pedalling support that’s simple to use. Combined with the higher capacity E8010 MTB battery delivering 504 Wh, you get a sleek integrated look and supported travel of up to 100km on a single charge.

A full carbon fork with tapered head tube, combined with flat bar specific stem lengths and geometry, result in confidence inspiring steering. With integrated cable routing, this bike keeps everything nice and tidy, allowing you to make the most of the bikes rack and mount capabilities. Fit mudguards to keep you dry, and a rear luggage rack to carry anything from your laptop to your shopping.
